claim: Determine whether relaxed confidence and intervention constraints reveal an Iterative P4 advantage without using formal-test outcomes for gate selection.
interval_definition: 95% percentile hierarchical bootstrap confidence interval; validation scenarios and model instances are resampled independently.
n_definition: Three independently trained model seeds crossed with 20 locked controller-validation scenario seeds per gate.
center_statistic: Grand mean across model and validation seeds.
baseline_definition: Greedy deployment policy evaluated on the identical validation scenarios.
train_validation_test_split: Gate comparisons use controller-validation seeds 8100001-8100020 only; formal-test seeds are prohibited.
multiple_comparison_correction: None; the 31-gate scan is explicitly exploratory and validation-only.
